description: Correction ledger (spec §7.1) — distilled rules from editorial corrections, arbiter-curated. The top rules ride in every generation prompt so the generator stops doing what editors most often fix. Append new rules when a generated→edited promotion diff reveals a recurring correction.
rules: Cut hype adjectives (powerful, amazing, revolutionary, game-changing) — make plain statements instead
Prefer one concrete number or named example over vague quantifiers like 'many platforms' or 'significantly better'
At most one sentence of introduction before the substance begins
Do not open sections with rhetorical questions
Define terms on first use at intro and standard depth; never re-define basics at research depth
Bold the key concept phrases (matching the book's existing style), not whole sentences
End with a forward hook or a concrete takeaway, not a summary that repeats the text
